mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past year signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the CPIAUCSL index above 5.0 in the next month triggers market concerns about inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the following 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 5.0 in the next month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 5.0, or t-test p >0.05 showing no significant negative effect.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rates and rise in GDP demand (GDPC1) signals accommodative monetary policy and robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases while GDPC1 increases in the same period
failure_condition: The interaction occurs but returns are not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05) over 60 days, or the correlation between the proxies and returns is weak (IC <0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 0.5% in the next three months indicates labor market tightening, reducing wage growth expectations and pressuring equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the following 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.5% in the next three months
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (t-test p >0.05) in >60% of triggered instances, or the regime condition is not met (UNRATE stays below 0.5%).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) over the past quarter signals labor market strength, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-month window, or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO below 90.0 in the next month signals weakening supply growth, reducing inflationary pressures and investor optimism, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the following 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 90.0 in the next month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in <30% of triggered instances despite INDPRO dropping below 90.0, or t-test p >0.05 showing no significant negative effect.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in supply growth (INDPRO) and demand (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases while GDPC1 increases in the same period
failure_condition: The interaction occurs but returns are not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05) over 60 days, or the correlation between proxies and returns is weak (IC <0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.0% in the next month signals monetary tightening, raising borrowing costs and pressuring equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the following 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% in the next month
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (t-test p >0.05) in >60% of triggered instances, or the regime condition is not met (FEDFUNDS stays below 4.0%).
